title.zh: 宗教理事会与卡迪法庭法修正命令 2014
title.en: RELIGIOUS COUNCIL AND KADIS COURTS ACT AMENDMENT ORDER 2014

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-15-2014-RELIGIOUS-COUNCIL-AND-KADIS-COURTS-ACT-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2014.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 8 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Religious Council and Kadis Courts Act Order, 2014 and shall commence on 1st May 2014. of section 2 of Chapter 77.

Section 2 of the Religious Council and Kadis Courts Act, in this Order to as the Act, is amended by inserting the following new definition after the definition of "habuan"- " "Hukum Syara' " means the laws of any sect which the Court considers valid;". of Part III.
The Act is amended by deleting "Jurisdiction" from the sub-heading of of new section 55A.

The Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately before section 56 - of Criminal Procedure Code (Chapter 7) and Hukum Syara ', 55A. In relation to any matter of practice and procedure in criminal not expressly provided for in this Act, any rules made or any other written law within the jurisdiction of the Court, the the Criminal Procedure Code (Chapter 7) apply with the modifications to the extent that they do not conflict with Hukum in which case, Hukum Syara' applies.".

Section 78 of the Act is repealed. =

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE

Section 169 of the Act is amended(a) by inserting "(1)" immediately before "Any" in the first line;

(b) by adding the following new subsection "t2) Whoever fails to report his renunciation of the Islamic religion in with subsection (1) shall be guilty of an offence: Penalty, a fine of $1,000.".
Section 180 of the Act is amended by repealing subsection !4).

Section 195 of the Act is amended -

(a) by deleting "or 173" from the fifth line; and

(b) by deleting "cognisable by a Magistrate's Court" from the fifth and sixth lines. day of Jamadilakhir, 1435 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of April, 2014 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
